title: Scribble-to-object Flow - user draws on the image, ControlNet + SDXL renders it in
description: Fabio, 2026-08-16. A Flow that turns the user's own DRAWING on top of their image into a rendered object stitched back into that image - a special inpaint driven by a scribble, not by a prompt alone. BENCH FIRST: author and prove the whole graph in the node graph, THEN wire it with /mpi-add-flow. No app work until the bench half is user-approved. Spec, open questions and the model/preprocessor choices: tasks/MPI-567/brief.md. MODEL CHOICE DECIDED 2026-08-21 (Fabio): base is SDXL Realistic and the user may pick any SDXL-family model - an any-of requiredModels set (MPI-590) over all five, with modelParams swapping Input_Base_Model. The bench half is much smaller than the brief assumes: every SDXL model already ships controlTypes depth/pose/scribble/canny behind ONE ControlNet-Union checkpoint switched by Input_Control_Net, so the flow DRIVES an existing branch rather than authoring one. Plan: plan.md.
acceptance: BENCH FIRST: the entire graph is authored and proven in the node graph, and Fabio approves real output BEFORE any app work

The flow drives the EXISTING SDXL ControlNet-Union branch via Input_Control_Net - it does not author a new ControlNet path (all five SDXL models already declare controlTypes depth/pose/scribble/canny)
The user picks the preprocessor - Scribble for a loose doodle, Canny for a clean structured drawing - and the step copy says which to pick in those words
The paint layer ALONE (not the composite) becomes the ControlNet hint on a flat background
SDXL samples only the region the drawing occupies, not the whole frame, and the result is stitched back at the recorded coordinates
The base model is SDXL Realistic, and the user may pick any installed SDXL-family model: an any-of requiredModels set with a modelParams arm per member, the default arm restated
The checkpoint loader is titled Input_Base_Model in the flow graph, and the swap is confirmed POSITIVELY on two arms - injection drops an unmatched title in silence
Consumers resolve the set through flowModelIds / flowModelChoices / setFlowModel / flowModelParams / flowSettingsModel - never by reading flow.requiredModels directly
tests/flow-model-choice.test.cjs is extended to cover this flow
No feather is added to the stitched object - the detailing pass is what blends (ruled on MPI-454, 2026-08-21)
brief.md's stale 'why no umbrella' board note is healed - MPI-529, MPI-552 and MPI-530 were merged into MPI-560 on 2026-08-16
Live-run and reuse both pass per docs/playbooks/add-flow/05-verify.md, with the picker exercised at two installed SDXL models
